basics.name: Valtteri Koskela
basics.label: Software architect with excellent programming skills
basics.summary:
Valtteri is a versatile software professional with a strong track record in delivering challenging projects across diverse domains.

With a solid background in software engineering, he combines deep technical expertise with domain understanding. As a mentor, he believes good architecture grows from real insight, not overdesign.

He actively follows advancements in developer tooling and uses AI agents daily to support development work from big-picture thinking to small details.
basics.x-tagline: Reliable code lays the groundwork, yet truly great software grows out of genuine care for its purpose and the people using it.

projects.name: Order and shipment management ERP renewal
projects.description: Total renewal of customer's order and shipment management system as custom ERP software solution running on Microsoft Azure. Design and implementation work of various subsystems. Team mentoring.

projects.name: Control system and web application development
projects.description: Software development for C#/React web applications and classic Windows desktop C++ applications. Control system component programming. Web backend programming. Architectural, performance, multi-threading and robustness improvements. Unit testing guidelines and examples. Git version control transition done from TFVC. Commucation backbone server and clients rewritten to use secure communications.

projects.name: 3D audio spatialization evaluation applications
projects.description: Unity (Hololens) & Python applications for evaluating 3D audio spatialization algorithms for MPEG-I standardization Dynamic import of custom 3D scene models from evaluation server

projects.name: Onboard mobile game for cruise ferries
projects.description: iOS and Android mobile game to be played on cruise ferries. Game activated onboard ships by Bluetooth LE beacon proximity detection. Onboard game winnings (digital vouchers) validated with external Node.js server. Heavily regulated customer domain.

projects.name: Elemental analyzer diagnostics application
projects.description: Elemental analyzers: HTML5 diagnostics application development for an elemental analyzer that's used for measuring mineral slurry elemental concentrations with Laser-induced Breakdown Spectroscopy (LIBS) technology. Software architecture design on top of customer’s generic web application stack

projects.name: Tunneling rig boom control and drilling instrumentation
projects.description: Software architecture design of the client's tunneling rig boom control and drilling instrumentation system on top of customer’s generic control system platform. Prototyping and implementation of subsystem distribution and data serialization, supporting multiple operating systems. Implementation of various subsystems.

projects.name: Variable speed drive control firmware
projects.description: Firmware programming for hard-realtime variable speed electric drive control system for industrial electric motor drives, running on customer’s dedicated DSP. Design and implementation of various control and monitoring subsystems. Code analysis and optimization on assembly level.

projects.name: Distributed control system for tunneling jumbos
projects.description: Distributed control system for the client's tunneling jumbos. These 50-ton vehicles are called to the scene when there's need to drill underground railroad, highway or metro tunnels etc. Higher level control system software architecture design (Bus data handling and distribution, drill plan management, boom sequence control, data collection, diagnostics etc). Implementation of various subsystems.

projects.name: Power transmission line compensation and protection system
projects.description: Extra-high voltage power transmission line compensation and protection system. Software development for protection and compensation stations used in electricity transmission grid. Redundant hard-realtime system with 100us control cycle, made with C++. Onsite system commissioning work for Voimalinja Oyj, Finland and Coastal Hydro Utility, Canada.

projects.name: Paper web quality measurement system
projects.description: Paper web quality measurement system. Several R&D projects for quality measurement sensors used in paper machines. Control system component programming in C for the company's automation system.

projects.name: Warehouse control systems
projects.description: Several warehouse control system projects based on company’s warehouse control system platform. Designed, implemented and deployed a crystallization warehouse control system for a confectionery manufacturer as his MSc thesis project. The system was used in the production of several of the manufacturer's candy products for well over a decade.
